recipes.cookingTime: Prep time: 05 mins • Total time: 10 mins
recipes.ingredients:
100 gr Spaghetti
50 gr Guanciale
20 gr Pecorino Romano + Parmigiano Reggiano
1 Egg yolk
Black pepper
recipes.name: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to the packaging
Bake Guanciale on low heat until the fat is released
Mix grated Pecorino Romano with the egg yolks
Add pasta to the Guanciale with fat
Combine and stir all ingredients together
